I’m not sure which order they’re from, so if you could look up the details for each order, that would be really helpful. Thanks!

For the water bottle, I’ll go with the glass, black 750ml option. The silver, low brightness, battery-powered desk lamp sounds good to me. Please proceed with those choices.
Actually, I’d like to just exchange the desk lamp for now. Please go ahead with exchanging the desk lamp only.
On second thought, I don’t want to exchange anything right now. Instead, I’d like to return the water bottle. Can you help me with that?
Yes, please go ahead and process the return for the water bottle. Thank you!
That’s all I needed for now. Thanks for your help! ###STOP###
